name: Vimma 0.1.25 · Firefox 161.0
body:
### Updating

- **macOS:** `brew upgrade --cask vimma`, or download `vimma-0.1.25-macos-aarch64.dmg`
  below and drag Vimma over the copy in Applications.
- **Linux:** `:update` shows the command for how you installed Vimma; the user guide's
  [Updates](https://github.com/vimma-browser/vimma/blob/main/docs/guide.md#updates) section lists them all.

## [0.1.25](https://github.com/vimma-browser/vimma/compare/v0.1.24...v0.1.25) · Firefox 161.0 (2026-11-26)


### Added

* **copy-mode:** gy copies the url of the link under the caret or the selection ([#1536](https://github.com/vimma-browser/vimma/issues/1536)) ([066ca72](https://github.com/vimma-browser/vimma/commit/066ca726a60d999c577b1b7bd45013ea6722fa6b)), closes [#1531](https://github.com/vimma-browser/vimma/issues/1531)
* **mcp:** separate configurable rates for new agent tabs and loads into a tab ([#1563](https://github.com/vimma-browser/vimma/issues/1563)) ([09d76c4](https://github.com/vimma-browser/vimma/commit/09d76c4be887655fb674d519eacf9938868ef8f2)), closes [#1561](https://github.com/vimma-browser/vimma/issues/1561)


### Fixed

* **bookmarks:** a private window's change during an apply is not written ([#1584](https://github.com/vimma-browser/vimma/issues/1584)) ([f613740](https://github.com/vimma-browser/vimma/commit/f613740663a9250fed29cecaef130a1b14c2c50d)), closes [#1576](https://github.com/vimma-browser/vimma/issues/1576)
* **build:** macOS artifact builds take no links from other apps ([#1575](https://github.com/vimma-browser/vimma/issues/1575)) ([c68dfce](https://github.com/vimma-browser/vimma/commit/c68dfceae693ab7877ca819beea99ad3fd42e693)), closes [#1571](https://github.com/vimma-browser/vimma/issues/1571)
* **dialogs:** a window dialog gives focus back to the hidden address bar on a slow machine ([#1558](https://github.com/vimma-browser/vimma/issues/1558)) ([408b0d4](https://github.com/vimma-browser/vimma/commit/408b0d4ddb0dbbb67ae694bcbf2f18643cfd8f8e)), closes [#1423](https://github.com/vimma-browser/vimma/issues/1423)
* **keys:** f7 in the address bar asks the caret browsing question once ([#1581](https://github.com/vimma-browser/vimma/issues/1581)) ([db699e9](https://github.com/vimma-browser/vimma/commit/db699e91f65f2b119cde252c28e19a4a9ce17730)), closes [#1557](https://github.com/vimma-browser/vimma/issues/1557)
* **mcp:** modified clicks in agent tabs open no tab or window ([#1585](https://github.com/vimma-browser/vimma/issues/1585)) ([054896f](https://github.com/vimma-browser/vimma/commit/054896ff03c17794e55eeb5f8ca778099e9688e6)), closes [#1568](https://github.com/vimma-browser/vimma/issues/1568)
* **prompts:** y and n answer passkey and security key prompts the right way round ([#1545](https://github.com/vimma-browser/vimma/issues/1545)) ([a3f38ed](https://github.com/vimma-browser/vimma/commit/a3f38ed44794b46ef869dba004f57e5bf1c8682e)), closes [#1544](https://github.com/vimma-browser/vimma/issues/1544)
* **routing:** route only links from outside the browser, never a typed url ([#1564](https://github.com/vimma-browser/vimma/issues/1564)) ([1847f8b](https://github.com/vimma-browser/vimma/commit/1847f8b1f3cc1fe2cca85c82df00ed9e12f6cb0b)), closes [#1562](https://github.com/vimma-browser/vimma/issues/1562)
* **updates:** on omarchy, the pacman repository's update hint is omarchy update ([#1556](https://github.com/vimma-browser/vimma/issues/1556)) ([c2f611f](https://github.com/vimma-browser/vimma/commit/c2f611f47b91b6ad307455c95fd62cb1d523f4a7)), closes [#1550](https://github.com/vimma-browser/vimma/issues/1550)

### Third-party notice

The AppImage starts with the unmodified AppImage type-2 runtime 20251108 (MIT), which
statically links libfuse 3.15.0 under the LGPL-2.1-or-later. Its source:
https://github.com/AppImage/type2-runtime/tree/20251108. The licence text and how to relink or replace the runtime are in
`usr/share/doc/vimma/` inside the AppImage (`--appimage-extract`). `vimma-ctl` links Rust's
standard library, and on Linux musl and LLVM's libunwind, into its binary; their notices are in
`vimma-ctl-licenses/` next to it, or in `Vimma.app/Contents/Resources/` on macOS. Vimma is
MPL-2.0; the CycloneDX SBOM lists the other components.
